title: Whole-brain immunolabeling, clearing, and light-sheet imaging of C-FOS in pigeons
author: Balay, Nordmann, et al.

steps.title: Stimulate, sacrifice, and perfuse birds
steps.instruction: Expose adult pigeons to continuous sensory stimulation for at least 1 h, then sacrifice and perfuse transcardially, dissect the brain, post‑fix and store.

substeps.instruction: Stimulate animals continuously for ≥1 h (C‑FOS peaks 1–2 h after stimulus).
Immediately sacrifice the animal and open the body cavity.
Release the heart from the pericardium and make an incision in the right auricle.
Perfuse 200 mL of 1× PBS‑Heparin (12 U/L) warmed to 37 °C into the left ventricle using a 23 G needle at 25 mL/min.
Switch to room‑temperature 4 % PFA and perfuse a further 200 mL.
Dissect the brain in 1× PBS, fully remove the dura mater, resect the optic chiasm at its base, open the cisterna magna over the brain stem, and leave ~1 cm of spinal cord attached.
Transfer each brain to a 50 mL Falcon tube and post‑fix in 25 mL 4 % PFA at 4 °C for 20 h (no rotation).
Remove PFA, add 50 mL 1× PBS cooled to 4 °C, and store brains at 4 °C until further processing.
For storage >1 month (max 2 months), add 0.02 % sodium azide to the PBS.

steps.title: Dehydrate brains in methanol series
steps.instruction: Gradually replace PBS with increasing concentrations of methanol/PBS, then treat with DCM/methanol and finish with methanol washes.

substeps.instruction: Dilute methanol in 1× PBS (prevents swelling). Perform two rinses per day (~12 h apart) in 10 % increments.
All steps at room temperature, shaking at 20 rpm unless noted; label tubes with a resistant method (e.g., diamond pen).
Warm 50 mL 1× PBS (4 °C) to 20–25 °C while shaking at 20 rpm.
Replace PBS with 50 mL 10 % methanol/1× PBS; shake overnight.
Next morning replace with 20 % methanol/1× PBS; continue 10 % increments each wash until 80 % methanol/1× PBS is reached (two washes per day).
Skip the 90 % methanol step (precipitate formation observed).
Wash twice in 100 % methanol over a day at room temperature.
Remove 100 % methanol and add >50 mL 66 % dichloromethane (DCM)/methanol; fill tubes to the top, shake overnight (handle DCM in a fume hood, store in a chemical cabinet).
Next day remove DCM/methanol and rinse with 100 % methanol three times, 1 h each at room temperature.
During the third methanol wash, place brains on a shaker at 4 °C for ~4 h until cooled.

steps.title: Rehydrate brains through methanol reverse series
steps.instruction: Return the brains to aqueous conditions by decreasing methanol concentration stepwise and finish with PBS.

substeps.instruction: Remove 100 % methanol and add 80 % methanol/1× PBS.
Rehydrate in 10 % methanol/1× PBS steps (two steps per day) until 20 % methanol/1× PBS is reached.
Remove 20 % methanol/1× PBS and rinse in 1× PBS overnight at room temperature on a shaker.

steps.title: Permeabilize brains
steps.instruction: Rinse in PT×.2 and incubate in freshly prepared permeabilization solution at 37 °C for 48 h.

substeps.instruction: Remove PBS and rinse twice, 3 h each, in PT×.2 solution.
Add freshly prepared, 0.2 µm sterile‑filtered permeabilization solution and incubate at 37 °C on a shaker for 48 h (add 0.02 % sodium azide to solutions kept at 37 °C).

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Incubate brains in blocking solution at 37 °C for 48 h (use 10 mL glass vials).

substeps.instruction: Remove permeabilization solution and add pre‑warmed, sterile‑filtered blocking solution.
Incubate at 37 °C on a shaker for 48 h (add 0.02 % sodium azide to the solution).

steps.title: Incubate with primary antibody
steps.instruction: Expose brains to mouse anti‑C‑FOS (1:300) in PTwH/5 % DMSO/3 % donkey serum for 12 days at 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Prepare sterile‑filtered PTwH containing 5 % DMSO and 3 % donkey serum; pre‑warm to 37 °C.
Engrave sample IDs on 10 mL glass vials with a diamond pen.
Rinse empty vials once with PTwH/5 % DMSO/3 % donkey serum just before transferring brains.
Discard blocking solution and transfer each brain to the appropriate vial.
Add 10 mL of primary antibody solution (mouse anti‑C‑FOS 1:300 in PTwH/5 % DMSO/3 % donkey serum).
Save 10 mL of the same solution without antibody as a negative‑control brain.
Wrap each vial lid with parafilm and place vials in a sterile box also wrapped with parafilm.
Incubate at 37 °C on a rotating shaker for 12 days in the dark (add 0.02 % sodium azide).

steps.title: Wash brains post‑primary
steps.instruction: Perform a series of PTwH washes to remove unbound primary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Remove primary antibody solution and store it at 4 °C (can be reused up to 6 months; re‑sterile filter 0.2 µm before reuse).
Transfer brains to fresh 50 mL Falcon tubes and fill with pre‑warmed PTwH.
Wash 1 h at 37 °C on a shaker.
Add fresh PTwH and wash overnight at 37 °C.
Next day wash with fresh PTwH three times, 2 h each, at 37 °C.

steps.title: Incubate with secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate brains in donkey anti‑mouse Alexa Fluor 647 (1:300) in PTwH/3 % donkey serum for 12 days at 37 °C in the dark.

substeps.instruction: Prepare sterile‑filtered PTwH containing 3 % donkey serum; pre‑warm to 37 °C.
Engrave sample IDs on 10 mL glass vials with a diamond pen.
Rinse empty vials once with PTwH/3 % donkey serum just before transferring brains.
In a darkened room, fill each vial with 10 mL secondary antibody solution (donkey anti‑mouse Alexa Fluor 647 1:300 in PTwH/3 % donkey serum).
Discard wash solution, transfer brains to the appropriate vial, wrap lids with parafilm, and place vials in a sterile plastic pipette‑tip box wrapped with parafilm.
Incubate at 37 °C on a rotating shaker for 12 days in the dark (add 0.02 % sodium azide).

steps.title: Wash brains post‑secondary
steps.instruction: Remove residual secondary antibody with PTwH washes at 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Remove secondary antibody solution and transfer brains to fresh light‑safe 50 mL Falcon tubes; fill with pre‑warmed PTwH.
Wash 1 h at 37 °C on a shaker.
Add fresh PTwH and wash overnight at 37 °C.
